adventure.name: Adventure
adventure.intro: Modpacks that make the world bigger and stranger: new biomes, structures, dungeons and mobs to explore with friends.
adventure.description: Adventure modpack server templates for Playkeeper: bigger worlds, new biomes and dungeons, each opened in your own dashboard in one click.

bedwars.name: Bedwars
bedwars.intro: Teams guard their bed while they gather resources to break everyone else's. Lose your bed and you're out at your next death.

cobblemon.name: Cobblemon
cobblemon.intro: Pokémon-style creatures to catch, train and battle in Minecraft, from the Cobblemon mod and the modpacks built on it.
cobblemon.description: Cobblemon server templates for Playkeeper: modpacks with Pokémon-style creatures to catch and battle, opened in your own dashboard in one click.

creative.name: Creative
creative.intro: Endless blocks and flight for builders, with world editing and a separate world for each project.
creative.description: Minecraft creative server templates for Playkeeper: WorldEdit, a world for each project, and one click to open one in your own dashboard.

hardcore-smp.name: Hardcore SMP
hardcore-smp.intro: One life each: the difficulty stays on hard, and a player who dies watches the rest of the world as a spectator.

lifesteal-smp.name: Lifesteal SMP
lifesteal-smp.intro: Survival with PvP, where a kill takes a heart from the loser and gives it to the winner, and running out of hearts puts you out.

oneblock.name: OneBlock
oneblock.intro: Each player stands on one block that turns into the next when broken, from grass and trees to the Nether and the End.

skyblock.name: Skyblock
skyblock.intro: Every player or team starts on a small island floating in the void, and builds out from almost nothing.

smp.name: SMP
smp.intro: Survival multiplayer for a group of friends: one shared world that keeps going, with plugins that keep it fair and easy to run.

towny.name: Towny
towny.intro: Players found towns, claim land chunk by chunk and join their towns into nations, with ranks and protection built in.
